main.description: Entry point for the maps3d photogrammetry pipeline. Triggers a single H3 tile through Mapillary fetch → image curation (LangGraph) → COLMAP CPU dense reconstruction → mesh simplification → Murakumo Vision annotation → actor disambiguation → LanceDB spatial ingest. BPMN-as-actor — invoked via `POST http://dispatcher.etzhayyim.com:8080/xrpc/com.etzhayyim.apps.maps3d.processTile` or auto-fired by timer-start R/PT15M against the maps3d tile queue (MST-backed). Real work runs in Murakumo cell handlers on the etzhayyim fleet per ADR-2605214000. Backed by `00-contracts/bpmn/com/etzhayyim/maps3d/processTile.bpmn` v1, `vertex_id = at://did:web:bpmn.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.apps.bpmn.processDef/maps3d-process-tile-v1`. PORT-adapted per ADR-2605214000 §2.

tileH3.description: H3 cell ID at resolution 12 (~9m edge) — the unit of reconstruction.

priority.description: Override row priority for this run (1 = landmark, 5 = backfill). Default reads from row.

force.description: Re-run even if status='done'. Default false.

instanceKey.description: LangServer run key — opaque identifier for tracing.
